Habits

You fall to the level of your systems

By James Clear · 6 min read · mock page for Skill Recorder evals

We often think progress comes from ambitious goals. But goals are about the results you want to achieve. Systems are about the processes that lead to those results.

You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.

If you want better results, forget about setting goals for a while. Focus on your system instead. The score takes care of itself when you tend to the inputs.

Small habits don't add up — they compound. That is why the seemingly minor choices you make each day matter far more than the occasional dramatic effort.
